title: Trash storage during municipal service disruption
summary: A home or apartment-block routine for managing trash when collection stops, roads close, animals scatter bags, or heat increases odor and insects.
content: Core sequence: 1) Separate food waste, sharp waste, hygiene waste, recyclables, and ash or batteries before storage. 2) Double-bag wet waste, squeeze out air carefully, and place it in the coolest shaded secure spot. 3) Keep a visible date tag and do not let bags block exits, stairwells, drains, or fire equipment. 4) If animals, insects, leakage, or odor increase, reduce volume by removing clean dry packaging and escalate the wet waste first.
